answer: Each identity must complete a verifier-chosen chain of sequential modular squarings, with every result required before the next step can begin. GPUs may run separate chains in parallel, but cannot shorten the elapsed time for any one chain; cloning identities therefore multiplies the work rather than removing the delay. The tundra, delta, and garden labels can distinguish challenges, while Sybil resistance depends on enforcing this per-identity time and resource cost.
